items.title: Anthropic announces closing of IPO and concurrent private placement
items.summary_en: Anthropic reported that its Class A shares began trading on Nasdaq (ticker ANT) on Nov 19 at $83.00. The IPO totaled about 1.127 billion shares including the full underwriters' option, with about $93.5B gross proceeds (about $91.6B to Anthropic). A concurrent private placement of about 313.3M Class N shares to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA and TSMC Partners raised about $26.0B, for roughly $119.5B combined gross.
items.notes: Corporate/financial announcement; category 'policy' is closest schema fit. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley were lead bookrunners. Figures as stated on the page.

items.title: Anthropic prices initial public offering
items.summary_en: Anthropic announced pricing of its IPO at $83.00 per Class A share, offering 980,000,000 shares (about 956.4M from Anthropic, about 23.6M from selling stockholders). Trading on Nasdaq Global Select Market under ANT was expected to start Nov 19, with closing expected Nov 20 and a 30-day underwriter option for up to 147M more shares.
items.notes: Corporate/financial announcement; category is closest schema fit. Superseded in part by the Nov 20 closing release (share count rose with option exercise).

items.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
items.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2, available on all platforms and clouds, and Mythos 5.2, the same model without some cyber and biology safeguards, limited to vetted organizations via its Cyber and Life Sciences Verification Programs. Anthropic reports outputs up to about 30% faster than Fable 5.1, gains over Opus 5.5 on most benchmarks, pricing of $8/$40 per million input/output tokens, and classifiers that block about 55% fewer legitimate requests than before. It also notes the model sometimes suspects it is being evaluated, and that training was adjusted to limit gains in AI R&D capability.
items.notes: Published 2 days before the 10-day window; included because it is the most recent model release and is directly relevant to this week's coverage. Capability claims are Anthropic's own, as reported on the page.

items.title: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed IPO
items.summary_en: Anthropic posted a newsroom announcement on Nov 10 launching the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering.
items.notes: Only the newsroom listing title and date were seen; the post itself was not fetched, so details are not summarized. Slightly outside the 10-day window; included as context for the IPO sequence.

coverage_note: Newsroom (anthropic.com/news) showed two posts inside the Nov 11-21 window, both IPO-related (pricing Nov 18, closing Nov 20); no new research, safety or model-release posts in that window. The most recent model release (Fable/Mythos 5.2) was Nov 9. Secondary press coverage was seen in search but deliberately excluded. Official social accounts and interview transcripts were not checked in this run, so absence there is not confirmed.
